title: The Lifecycle of "Facts": A Survey of Social Bias in Knowledge Graphs
findings: An analysis of the ConceptNet knowledge graph found that several Islam-related entities were associated with negative semantic polarity, while entities related to Christianity and Hinduism were more ambiguously valuated. Additionally, experiments in adversarial learning to remove religious bias from embeddings were not fully successful, as related information still informed the bias.
references: Abubakar Abid, Maheen Farooqi, and James Zou. 2021. Large language models associate Muslims with violence. Nature Machine Intelligence, 3(6):461–463.
